sources.role: standalone options, SDL runtime input, ROM/CMOS/SRAM and state paths

paths.path: None: command-line options only; the standalone source does not load fmsx.ini
paths.naming: No persistent native configuration file is established.

paths.path: Runtime SDL controllers; no persisted native profile
paths.naming: -joy <type>: 0 none, 1 normal joystick, 2 mouse joystick, 3 mouse real mode; Unix SDL opens the first two controllers.
evidence: source:EMULib/Unix/LibSDL2.c SDL controller enumeration and mapping @ fd5fac3

paths.naming: SRAM files are generated beside cartridges when the mapper exposes SRAM.

paths.path: -state <filename>, default DEFAULT.STA in the program working directory
paths.naming: The explicit state filename controls .STA load/save.
evidence: source:fMSX/fMSX.c -state parser and MSX.c STAName default @ fd5fac3

paths.naming: System resources include MSX.ROM, MSX2.ROM, MSX2EXT.ROM, MSX2P.ROM, MSX2PEXT.ROM, FMPAC.ROM, DISK.ROM, MSXDOS2.ROM, PAINTER.ROM and KANJI.ROM; CMOS.ROM is writable nonvolatile state.
evidence: source:fMSX/MSX.c LoadROM and CMOS.ROM save path @ fd5fac3

paths.naming: No key file or checksum is claimed.
